title: 1,000 YEARS
sub: In a green valley in central Vietnam, red brick towers rise out of the jungle. Some of them are more than a thousand years old.
say: In a green valley in central Vietnam, red brick towers rise out of the jungle. Some of them are more than a thousand years old.

title: CHAMPA
sub: The people who built them ruled parts of this coast for more than a thousand years. Their kingdom was called Champa.
say: The people who built them ruled parts of this coast for more than a thousand years. Their kingdom was called Chahm-pah.

title: SEA POWER
sub: It was a sea power that traded with China and sacked a Vietnamese capital.
say: It was a sea power that traded with China and sacked a Vietnamese capital.

title: STILL HERE
sub: Today, Champa has no capital and no state. But its people are still here.
say: Today, Chahm-pah has no capital and no state. But its people are still here.

title: HOW DID IT END?
sub: So how does a thousand-year kingdom end, while its people stay?
say: So how does a thousand-year kingdom end, while its people stay?
